title: Deterministic resource and termination boundary

budgets.process_count: maximum process-tree members including the root
budgets.process_depth: maximum process-tree depth including the root

enforcement.cancellation: accept only when requested and acknowledged
enforcement.observation_type: non-negative integers no greater than 2^63-1 and booleans

privacy.allowed: normalized counters, booleans, stable public identifiers, digests

limitations: The reference model evaluates supplied deterministic observations only.
It does not set OS limits, inspect a process tree, measure a host, send network traffic, or cancel a process.
Passing evidence does not establish real host enforcement or runtime/provider success.
follow_up: A later integration task must bind these checks to an OS-specific supervisor and independently evidence enforcement.
